{'text': '上星期五（21日）支聯會案裁決期間，喺清晨時段，警方將一名排緊隊旁聽嘅女子押上警車帶走。警方回覆查詢時表示，該名女子涉嫌「公眾地方擾亂秩序行為」、「抗拒或故意阻撓警方執行職務」同「煽動意圖」等三項罪名被捕。', 'target': 'Last Friday (the 21st), during the verdict of the Hong Kong Alliance case, a woman queuing for a court hearing was taken away in a police vehicle by officers in the early hours. In response to inquiries, the police stated that the woman was arrested on three charges: "disorderly conduct in a public place," "resisting or willfully obstructing a police officer in the execution of duty," and "seditious intent."'}

{'text': '上周五清晨五時許，超過50人已經喺西九龍裁判法院外面排緊隊，期間一名便衣警察指，一名排隊嘅女士「懷疑件衫有少少煽動意圖」，將佢帶上警車離開。警員帶走該名女子期間，幾名警員一路指示記者離開，並話「帶你去記者採訪區」，將橙色封鎖線拉至近英華街嘅方向，等到該名女子登上警車之後，就收起封鎖線。當日有排喺該名女士附近嘅「旁聽師」指，該名女子著住黑色T-Shirt，上面印有日文字。', 'target': 'Shortly after 5 a.m. last Friday, more than 50 people were already queuing outside the West Kowloon Magistrates\' Courts, when a plainclothes police officer indicated that a woman in the queue was suspected of wearing clothing with "a bit of seditious intent," and took her away in a police vehicle. While officers were taking the woman away, several officers kept directing reporters to leave, saying "take you to the press area," and extended an orange cordon toward Ying Wa Street. The cordon was only retracted after the woman had boarded the police vehicle. "Court-watching" citizens who were queuing near the woman that day said she was wearing a black T-shirt with Japanese characters printed on it.'}

{'text': '《集誌社》向警方查詢該名女子被帶走嘅原因，以及警方有冇作出拘捕。警方今（24日）早回覆話，8月21日喺西九龍法院一帶進行安保行動期間，一名45歲女子涉嫌「公眾地方擾亂秩序行為」、「抗拒或故意阻撓警方執行職務」同「煽動意圖」罪被捕，現正被扣留調查。', 'target': 'The Collective (集誌社) inquired with the police about the reasons the woman was taken away and whether she had been arrested. The police replied this morning (the 24th) that during a security operation in the vicinity of the West Kowloon Courts on August 21, a 45-year-old woman was arrested on suspicion of "disorderly conduct in a public place," "resisting or willfully obstructing a police officer in the execution of duty," and "seditious intent." She is currently being detained for investigation.'}
